topic.title: Content Search
topic.shortdesc: Use the Content tab to search for files that contain the specified keywords within the entire project.

body.p: In the Content tab within the Workspace Search view, enter the text you want to search for in the search text field at the top of the page. The search looks for matches in the text of project files. See for advanced options. A short reference is also available by clicking the help icon () next to the search field.

To the right of the search field, there is a Limit results to resources referenced from the publication map toggle button that can be enabled to funnel the searched results to only show results from topics referenced in the current publication map. This is useful in cases where a project contains multiple publication maps.

For each found result, you can double-click (or press Enter) to open that file in the visual editor. While hovering over a result, additional actions become available in top-right corner of the result:
Open in editor - Opens the topic in the visual editor.
Insert as link - Inserts a link to the result in the current document.
Insert as related link - Inserts a related link to the result in the current document.
